//: Maps ast_dst's own concepts onto its schema (dogfood). Run: go run ./cmd/astdst --root . --config presets/self.json. Most slots are honest gaps: an AST-walker is not a weighted fault-injecting state machine, so it has no op table, no invariant catalogue, and no TLA+ spec of its own. The two slots that DO map are real structures in the source.
//faults: The verification toolchain's two phases ARE its failure-bearing stages: SANY (syntax) and TLC (model-check) — exactly where a drafted spec is found defective. The typed `Phase` enum is the only enum in the tree.
//invariants: ast_dst has no safety-property catalogue (no `var Invariants = []T{...}`). Disabled -> honest gap.
//operations: ast_dst has no weighted dispatch table (no `var opTable = [N]func{...}` / weights). Disabled -> honest gap.
//tla: Disabled. The default specDir (../docs/tla) points at CharterTrace's real spec, OUTSIDE ast_dst; a true self-map must not reach there.
//state: The Model struct IS the mutable state the pipeline acts on; its fields are the natural TLA+ VARIABLES of 'astdst the program'.
